name: LLM VRAM dataset
description: Estimated memory for 29 open-weight language models at six quantisations and each common context length, and how each fits 13 GPUs. Architecture values are read from each model's config.json; GPU specs are the manufacturers'.
citation: Nodegrove (2026). LLM VRAM dataset (version 2026-09-25) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22966137

findings.headline: Newer models pay far less for context.
findings.detail: At 32k tokens, Qwen3 32B (2025, standard attention) spends 8.6 GB on its KV cache; its successor Qwen3.8 27B (2026, hybrid attention) spends 2.3 GB. Across all 29 models, each 1,000 tokens of context costs between 0.006 GB (Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B) and 0.328 GB (DeepSeek-R1 Distill Llama 70B).

findings.headline: Active parameters set the speed, not the memory.
findings.detail: Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B-A3B reads 3B parameters per token but keeps all 79.7B in memory: 48.9 GB at Q4_K_M with 8k context, against 22.4 GB for the dense Qwen3 32B.

findings.headline: 24 of 29 models fit a 24 GB card at Q4_K_M with 8k context.
findings.detail: The largest is Qwen3.6 35B-A3B at 22.4 GB, under the 22.8 GB line (95% of the card).

files.name: llm-vram.json
files.about: Everything above in one file, with the method, its constants and each model's cache layout

method.kv_cache_gb: For each group of attention layers: layers × values cached per token × min(context, window) × 2 bytes (FP16) or 1 byte (Q8), plus fixed_state_gb. See kv_groups on each model
method.fit: A model fits when need_gb ≤ 0.95 × usable_gb; tight when need_gb > 0.85 × usable_gb
method.tokens_per_second_ceiling: 0.7 × bandwidth_gb_s ÷ (active parameters, billions × bytes_per_param). Single stream, decode only; a ceiling, not a measurement

quants.note: the common default; small quality loss

models.model_id: Stable identifier, also the page slug on nodegrove.io
models.params_b: Total parameters, billions, as the checkpoint reports them. Mixture-of-experts models count every expert; multimodal checkpoints include the vision encoder
models.active_params_b: Parameters read per token, billions. Mixture-of-experts models only; blank for dense models
models.attention: How the model caches context: standard, sliding-window, hybrid or latent (see the method)
models.kv_heads: Key/value heads of the main attention layers
models.full_cache_layers: Layers whose cache grows with the whole context
models.window_layers: Layers that only keep the last window_tokens tokens
models.window_tokens: Sliding-window length in tokens; blank if the model has none
models.kv_cache_gb_per_1k_tokens: Memory each extra 1,000 tokens of context costs, GB, with an FP16 cache once any windows are full
models.fixed_state_gb: Fixed recurrent state of linear-attention or Mamba layers, GB. Does not grow with context
models.context_tokens: Native context window in tokens (max_position_embeddings, or the model card where the two differ)
models.license: Licence of the weights, from the model card
models.license_permissive: true when the licence has no field-of-use or scale conditions
models.role: code or reasoning for specialist models; blank for general-purpose models
models.successor_id: Newer model in the same family and role, if there is one
models.hf_repo: Hugging Face repository the values were read from
models.hf_gated: true when config.json opens only after accepting the licence on Hugging Face
models.config_url: Link to the config.json the architecture values come from
models.attention_detail: The attention layout in one sentence
models.notes: Caveats that change how the numbers should be read

gpus.gpu_id: Stable identifier, also the page slug on nodegrove.io
gpus.memory_gb: Memory from the manufacturer specification, GB (unified memory for Apple silicon)
gpus.usable_gb: Memory an inference runtime can address, GB. Apple silicon gives the GPU about 75% of unified memory by default
gpus.budget_gb: 95% of usable_gb: the line a model must fit under to count as fitting
gpus.bandwidth_gb_s: Memory bandwidth from the manufacturer specification, GB/s

requirements.quant: FP16, Q8_0, Q6_K, Q5_K_M, Q4_K_M or Q3_K_M
requirements.bytes_per_param: Effective bytes per parameter at that quantisation
requirements.kv_cache_gb: KV cache stored at FP16, plus any fixed state, GB
requirements.overhead_gb: Runtime context and buffers: 0.5 GB + 4% of weights
requirements.total_gb_q8_cache: The same total with the KV cache quantised to 8 bits

fit.context_tokens: Context the fit is computed at (8,192 tokens)
fit.need_gb: Estimated memory at that quantisation and context, GB (total_gb in llm-vram-requirements.csv)
fit.verdict: fits: need_gb is within the GPU's budget_gb. tight: it fits, but above 85% of usable memory. no: it does not fit
fit.max_context_tokens: Longest context that fits at this quantisation with an FP16 cache, capped at 131,072 tokens or the model's window. 0 when the weights alone do not fit
fit.tokens_per_second_ceiling: Upper bound on single-stream generation speed, tokens/s (see the method). Blank when the model cannot load
